facts.business: MOIL Limited is a Miniratna Central Public Sector Enterprise under the Ministry of Steel engaged in the mining and production of manganese ore, ferro manganese, and electrolytic manganese dioxide (EMD) in Maharashtra and Madhya Pradesh.

capacity_or_capex.item: Capex for environmental and social impact improvements (Tiger Corridor protection at Chikla Mine)

guidance_or_targets.statement: Enhance production to 3.50 million tonnes by 2030 as per Strategic Management Plan-2030 (SMP-2030)

key_risks: Cyclical nature of steel industry impacting manganese ore demand
Slowdown in steel demand and oversupply from international markets at cheaper rates
Labour intensive operations with associated industrial relations risks
Pressure on manganese ore prices globally
